sources.title: City of Issaquah — Remodel permit
sources.supports: Remodel permit required for all SF/duplex interior remodels; apply online only via MyBuildingPermit; paper not accepted; links to submittal packet and fee categories (valuation-based permit, plan check %, mechanical/plumbing schedules, technology surcharge, state building code fee); water meter sizing form; King County sewer form if ADU.

sources.title: City of Issaquah — Single-Family Interior Remodel Submittal Requirements
sources.supports: MBP path Building / Single-Family Residential / Remodel / Residence; plumbing and mechanical included with remodel package; cover sheet, site plan, architectural, plumbing/mechanical drawings; fixture counts; water meter sizing; utility service application; electrical permits by Washington L&I; City business license required; CPD@issaquahwa.gov; 425-837-3100.

sources.title: City of Issaquah — Do I Need a Permit?
sources.supports: City administers permits inside city limits; Klahanie under Sammamish; Mirrormont unincorporated King County; general permit trigger language; finish-work style exemptions list; Permit Center 425-837-3100; address 130 E Sunset Way.

sources.title: City of Issaquah — Permitting
sources.supports: MyBuildingPermit submittals; CPD@issaquahwa.gov; Permit Center phone 425-837-3100; status/inspections via MyBuildingPermit; 2021 IBC/IFC adoption note effective March 15, 2024.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit.com
sources.supports: Regional online permitting portal used by Issaquah for remodel applications.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit Tip Sheet 00 — Permits Required / Not Required (June 11, 2026)
sources.supports: Issaquah listed among MBP members; kitchen/bath fixture replacements without plumbing line modifications typically not requiring building permit; interior finish work; critical/shoreline/sensitive/WUI caveat; Issaquah electrical circuits/services shown as required.

sources.title: MyBuildingPermit — Inspection scheduling
sources.supports: Online inspection scheduling portal used with MyBuildingPermit jurisdictions.

sources.title: Washington L&I — City electrical permits and inspections list
sources.supports: Cities that issue their own electrical permits; Issaquah not listed (unlike Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Renton, Sammamish).

sources.title: Washington L&I — Electrical permits, fees, and inspections
sources.supports: State electrical permitting overview for jurisdictions where L&I issues electrical permits.
